name: After § 41
title: REPORT on the control of the financial activities of the European Investment Bank – annual report 2023
part_text: 41a. Calls on the EIB Group to establish a Group-wide comprehensive and binding whistleblower protection policy in line with Directive (EU) 2019/19371a, ensuring secure reporting channels, protection against retaliation, and full follow-up mechanisms; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a Directive (EU) 2019/1937 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 23 October 2019 on the protection of persons who report breaches of Union law,* OJ L 305, 26.11.2019, p. 17, *ELI:[http://data.europa.eu/eli/dir/2019/1937/oj](http://data.europa.eu/eli/dir/2019/1937/oj).
